_meta.description: Real Intuit QuickBooks Online webhook delivery. A single POST batches MULTIPLE eventNotifications[], EACH carrying its OWN realmId (a connected company = a distinct Fyralis tenant), and within each notification dataChangeEvent.entities[] lists MULTIPLE changed entities. Here: realm A (Invoice + Bill) and realm B (Payment) → 3 (realm,entity) fan-out units across 2 tenants. The intuit-signature header is base64(HMAC-SHA256(raw_body)) keyed by the APP-LEVEL verifier token (one per app, shared across realms), so a single verification authenticates the whole batch. Doc-derived; ids/timestamps are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/webhooks (eventNotifications[].realmId + dataChangeEvent.entities[] with name/id/operation/lastUpdated; intuit-signature = base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body keyed by the app verifier token)

headers.intuit-signature: <base64(HMAC-SHA256(raw_body)) keyed by the app verifier token; the contract test recomputes it>
